answer: Picture a marketplace where every new agent must lock a bond that only unlocks after ninety days of honest work. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand accounts must freeze a thousand bonds, and if auditors spot those accounts acting as a mirror of one another, voting in lockstep and funded from one source, every bond is slashed together. No sable cloak of fresh keys hides that pattern. The attacker who hoped to flood the network by dawn instead watches capital vanish before earning a cent.
